status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Evans is considered day-to-day after sustaining a rib strain during Sunday's 36-30 win over the Cardinals, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
status.longComment: Following his early exit from Sunday's game, Evans underwent a full evaluation Monday that revealed no significant injury. Even so, Evans' practice participation in Week 4 could be affected as the 49ers prepare for a matchup next Sunday against the Broncos. With four receivers already on injured reserve, the 49ers can ill afford an absence from Evans, who has recorded 12 catches for 137 yards and two touchdowns on 16 targets through the club's first three games.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: The 49ers placed Robinson (ankle) on injured reserve Saturday.
status.longComment: Robinson was carted off the field due to a right ankle injury during San Francisco's Week 2 win against the Dolphins, after which coach Kyle Shanahan relayed that the wide receiver likely suffered a high-ankle sprain. On Monday, Shanahan said that Robinson was facing a recovery timeline of 3-to-6 weeks, so this move to injured reserve doesn't come as a surprise. Robinson will be first eligible to return to action Sunday, Oct. 25 in Atlanta, but with all of Christian Kirk (calf), De'Zhaun Stribling (ankle), Ricky Pearsall (knee) and Robinson on IR, the 49ers will be going with Mike Evans (hip), Deebo Samuel, Jacob Cowing, Jordan Watkins and KhaDarel Hodge at wide receiver this Sunday against the Cardinals.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Williams (neck) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Cardinals, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
status.longComment: Williams was carted off the field and into the locker room during the third quarter, so he figures to be closer toward the doubtful side of returning to Sunday's contest. Vederian Lowe figures to take over at left tackle in Williams' absence.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: The 49ers placed West (undisclosed) on injured reserve Wednesday.
status.longComment: It remains unclear what issue is sidelining the second-year player. West will now need to miss at least four games on IR before becoming eligible to return to the active roster. The defensive tackle has logged five tackles (one solo) over 49 defensive snaps in the 49ers' first two regular-season games.

status.label: Out
status.shortComment: Thompson (ankle) won't play in San Francisco's Week 4 matchup versus the Broncos, Jennifer Lee Chan of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.
status.longComment: Thompson is in line to miss a second consecutive game due to the high-ankle sprain he suffered during the Week 2 win over the Dolphins. While there's currently no timetable for his return, his next chance to play will be the Week 6 matchup against Seattle.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Halton (ankle) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against Arizona, Jennifer Lee Chan of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.
status.longComment: Halton had to be helped off the field by trainers after sustaining an ankle injury, and he's been taken to the locker room for further evaluation. Naquan Jones, Kevin Givens and Sebastian Valdez are all in line for more defensive snaps for as long as Halton is out of the game.

status.label: Out
status.shortComment: Coach Kyle Shanahan said Monday that Bosa (calf) won't play this coming Sunday against the Broncos, Cam Inman of The San Jose Mercury News reports.
status.longComment: After Bosa strained his calf at practice last Thursday, Shanahan told Matt Barrows of The Athletic that the pass rusher would miss "a few weeks," so a second consecutive absence in Week 4 comes as no surprise. The 49ers started Ogbo Okoronkwo and Keion White at defensive end during Sunday's win versus the Cardinals and likely will continue to lean on the duo until Bosa is able to return to action.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Greenlaw (quadriceps) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Cardinals, Eric Branch of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.
status.longComment: Greenlaw sustained the injury early in the fourth quarter, and he's been off the field being monitored by training staff since his exit. Garret Wallow is in the game at weak-side linebacker in Greenlaw's absence.
